description_expanded: Dune Villas 2A - Beachfront Luxury Vacation Condo with Community Pool on 30A Favorite Features: - Beachview - Community Pool - Fireplace More about Dune Villas 2A: Dune Villas 2A is a magnificent residence that offers an unparalleled combination of elegance, comfort, and natural beauty. Nestled along the picturesque coastline of the Gulf of Mexico, this condo provides a truly idyllic beachfront living experience. Sleeping up to four guests, this one bedroom condo is the perfect location for a single family or romantic getaway for two. Slip away to find your paradise at Dune Villas 2A! Upon entering the condo, you are greeted by an open and spacious floor plan designed to maximize both natural light and stunning ocean views. The interior is adorned with high-end finishes, exquisite detailing, and contemporary furnishings that create a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere. One of the standout features of this luxurious condo is the fireplace, which serves as a focal point in the living area. Whether you're enjoying a cozy evening indoors or simply looking to add an extra touch of warmth and ambiance, the fireplace provides the perfect setting for relaxation and comfort. You'll have direct access to the pristine white sand beaches that the area is famous for. Step outside onto your balcony and soak in breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico, while listening to the soothing sound of waves crashing against the shore. Dune Villas 2A features a bright and inviting white kitchen with stainless steel appliances, offering a modern and sleek aesthetic. The kitchen is designed to be functional and visually appealing, with ample counter space and bar seating for four.  There is one well-appointed bedroom, designed to be a peaceful sanctuary. The neutral color scheme continues here, providing a calm and soothing environment for rest and relaxation. If additional sleeping arrangements are required, the living room sofa pulls out into a queen sleeper.  In addition to the captivating interior, this condo offers access to a community pool. It provides a refreshing retreat for guests to cool off and unwind. Whether you prefer to bask in the sun on a lounge chair or take a leisurely swim in the sparkling waters, the pool area offers a tranquil oasis for outdoor enjoyment. Seagrove Beach itself is renowned for its laid-back coastal charm and natural beauty. It offers a wealth of recreational activities such as swimming, snorkeling, paddle-boarding, and fishing, allowing you to fully embrace the beachfront lifestyle. Overall, this beachfront luxury condo in Seagrove Beach, Florida is a dream retreat that combines exquisite design, breathtaking views, and resort-style amenities. It provides the perfect setting to enjoy the serenity of the beach, the warmth of the fireplace, and the vibrant community atmosphere of this beautiful coastal town. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Additional Arrangements:  Full Sleeper Sofa
